description:
In 2025, Manulife conducted a survey across several Asian countries, with many participants from Japan as well. The Asia Care Survey 2025 explored how people perceive their physical, mental, and financial well-being in an aging society, and how Manulife can support them. The results revealed that many people in Japan feel significant anxiety about their life in retirement and the longevity of their assets, and they lack confidence in their ability to prepare for the future they hope to achieve. To build a better future, early planning is essential.
